agents.name: Stoquify Command Agent
agents.description: Role-aware operating copilot that turns trusted Stoquify evidence into concise briefs, ranked actions, explanations, and safe workflow routing without owning business truth.

agents.name: Stoquify Exception and Action Orchestrator
agents.description: Shared control-plane orchestrator that converts trusted signals into deduplicated cases and manages skills, state, approvals, retries, deadlines, escalation, and terminal outcomes.

agents.name: Stoquify Cash and Reconciliation Agent
agents.description: Evidence-backed cash and reconciliation copilot that triages payment exceptions, suggests reviewable matches, exposes evidence gaps, and prepares close-safe resolution packets.

agents.name: Stoquify Inventory and Replenishment Agent
agents.description: Location-aware inventory copilot that detects stock risk, explains event-backed variance, and prepares replenishment or transfer proposals with cash impact and confidence.

agents.name: Stoquify Purchasing and Accounts Payable Agent
agents.description: Controlled purchasing and AP copilot that explains three-way-match variance, supplier commitments, and payment risk while preserving maker-checker separation.

agents.name: Stoquify Close and Compliance Agent
agents.description: Evidence and country-pack aware close copilot that explains blockers, sequences remediation, assembles proof, and states exact compliance support without self-certifying.

agents.name: Stoquify Platform Assurance Agent
agents.description: Independent internal assurance agent that monitors evaluations, denials, drift, cost, latency, incidents, and evidence quality and can suspend unsafe versions without self-certifying them.

agents.name: Stoquify Customer Success and Adoption Agent
agents.description: Consent-aware adoption copilot that converts reliable product telemetry and versioned playbooks into role-specific onboarding, training, and workflow recommendations.

agents.name: Stoquify Payroll and Workforce Agent
agents.description: Privacy-bounded payroll readiness copilot that identifies input gaps and explains aggregate variance within one expert-reviewed country pack and separate employee self-service scopes.
